fixes.q: In which state is the highest peak of India, Kanchenjunga, located?
fixes.reason: Correct elevation is 8,586 m per Survey of India and modern surveys.

fixes.q: Which statement about the 2019 Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) notification is correct?
fixes.quote: It retained the 500 m HTL buffer and added a hazard line.
fixes.correction: It retained the 500 m HTL buffer and the hazard line.
fixes.reason: Hazard line existed in 2011 CRZ notification; 2019 retained it, not added.
